tasks.label: Docker: Compilar y Levantar con Docker Compose
tasks.command: docker compose down; cd backend/ms-user; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-auth; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-donation; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-campaign; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../bff; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../api-gateway; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../..; docker compose up --build

tasks.label: K8s: Compilar y Desplegar en Kubernetes
tasks.command: Write-Host 'Eliminando despliegues anteriores en K8s...'; kubectl delete -f backend/ms-user/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; kubectl delete -f backend/ms-auth/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; kubectl delete -f backend/ms-donation/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; kubectl delete -f backend/ms-campaign/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; kubectl delete -f backend/bff/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; kubectl delete -f backend/api-gateway/k8s/ --ignore-not-found=true; Write-Host 'Compilando microservicios con Gradle...'; cd backend/ms-user; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-auth; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-donation; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../ms-campaign; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../bff; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../api-gateway; ./gradlew.bat clean bootJar; cd ../..; Write-Host 'Construyendo imágenes Docker locales para K8s...'; docker build -t donaton-proyect-ms-user:latest ./backend/ms-user; docker build -t donaton-proyect-ms-auth:latest ./backend/ms-auth; docker build -t donaton-proyect-ms-donation:latest ./backend/ms-donation; docker build -t donaton-proyect-ms-campaign:latest ./backend/ms-campaign; docker build -t donaton-proyect-bff:latest ./backend/bff; docker build -t donaton-proyect-api-gateway:latest ./backend/api-gateway; Write-Host 'Desplegando en Kubernetes...'; kubectl apply -f backend/ms-user/k8s/; kubectl apply -f backend/ms-auth/k8s/; kubectl apply -f backend/ms-donation/k8s/; kubectl apply -f backend/ms-campaign/k8s/; kubectl apply -f backend/bff/k8s/; kubectl apply -f backend/api-gateway/k8s/; Write-Host '¡Despliegue en K8s completado!'
